text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Consumption of animal products in the EAT-Lancet diet 2017
Recommended intakes of animal products in the EAT-Lancet diet are shown relative to average daily per capita
supply by country. The EAT-Lancet diet is a diet recommended to balance the goals of healthy nutrition and
environmental sustainability for a global population.

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations and EAT-Lancet Commission (2019)
Diets by country are given as food supply – this is higher than actual intakes because it does not correct for consumer waste.
